title: Ouroboros Tree Serpent
description: A muscular female figure with a monstrous fanged face and wild white hair forms the body of a large green ouroboros serpent that coils in an infinity loop. The serpent emerges from a gnarled black tree with a screaming face and glowing white eyes, set against a background of white gears, flowers, and glowing orbs on a black and olive green field.
prompt: A surreal symbolic illustration featuring a fierce female monster with wild white hair and yellow eyes whose body transforms into a large green scaly ouroboros serpent coiled in an infinity shape. The serpent emerges from a twisted black tree with a screaming face and glowing eyes at the bottom. Background contains intricate white gears, chrysanthemum-like flowers, and floating glowing orbs on a black and olive green field, detailed linework with flat coloring.
